minutes.headline: Select Board gave Embers Pizzeria a warning for an underage alcohol sale and renewed town licenses.
minutes.summary: The board held a license violation hearing for Embers Pizzeria, found a violation and issued a warning. It heard the Hilltop Farms license transfer and renewed alcohol, entertainment, common victualler and auto dealer licenses. The town manager reported on the facilities charette, Complete Streets, online meeting posting, the TC Passios kitchen permitting and the firefighters contract.

what_happened.line: The Select Board found a license violation by Embers Pizzeria and issued a warning consistent with other violations; the recorded votes are marked not audible.
The board approved the four requested items for the Hilltop Farms license transfer.
The board approved alcohol, entertainment and other miscellaneous, common victualler, and class one, two and three auto dealer license renewals for 2018.
The town manager said the Complete Streets public forum will be held at the January 9th workshop.
The town manager will arrange a joint meeting of the Board of Health, selectmen and sewer commission on permitting the TC Passios kitchen.

why_it_matters: Licence warnings and renewals set which local restaurants, shops and dealers may operate and serve alcohol in 2018, and a warning is the record the board refers to in later violations.
The Complete Streets forum and the TC Passios kitchen permitting meeting are the points where residents can weigh in on street plans and on how a sewer-connected food business is permitted.
watch_next: The January 9th workshop, where the Complete Streets public outreach forum is to be held.
The joint meeting of the Board of Health, selectmen and sewer commission on the TC Passios kitchen, which the minutes give no date for.
